title: AMAN Gate - Performance Benchmark
notes: In-process measurement of the enforcement core (no HTTP/network).
policy_decision_ms is the deterministic allow/deny/approval decision (schema + ACL/destination checks) plus the advisory risk score, as recorded on each audit event — this is the decision cost.
advisory_risk_ms isolates the optional ML + heuristic latency, measured separately per the brief; it is a component of policy_decision_ms, not additive on top of it.

end_to_end_ms additionally includes the durable, tamper-evident audit write (SQLite fsync), which dominates the wall time and is a persistence cost rather than a policy-logic cost. A production deployment would batch/stream audit writes (e.g. WAL group commit or append to a log service).
